name: Power sector instruments
description: Laws, regulations, decisions and plans that govern electricity generation, networks, markets and pricing in the countries currently covered.

name: Energy and climate instruments
description: Economy-wide energy, fuel, transport and climate instruments that affect energy demand, supply or prices.

name: Supply chain, industrial and trade instruments
description: Instruments on the manufacture, investment in and trade of clean energy technologies (solar PV, wind, batteries, electric vehicles, grid equipment) and their mineral inputs, for the economies of the lab's Asia-Pacific green economic transition work.

name: Power sector instruments in the remaining ASEAN member states
description: Extension of the power-core module to the six remaining member states, in the order set out in docs/scouting/rest-of-asean.md.
